findings.claim: FreightWaves 報導：UP-NS 合併後，分析師預期 J.B. Hunt、Schneider、STG Logistics 等中介運輸客戶可能調整東部鐵路夥伴，STG 可能由 CSX 轉往 NS（預期，非已發生）
findings.source: FreightWaves《UP-NS merger puts intermodal giants on the wrong side of the map》
findings.excerpt: Schneider and number four STG Logistics ride Union Pacific (NYSE: UNP) and CSX (NASDAQ: CSX) trains. This leaves the companies unable to tap the benefits of coast-to-coast single-line service should the merger receive regulatory approval. Rival and second-place Hub Group (NASDAQ: HUB) sits in the sweetspot, using UP and NS. Intermodal analyst Larry Gross is among the industry observers

note: 查過三條：未找到 CSX 單一最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的來源；10-K/10-Q 搜尋未見單一客戶集中揭露。相關線索僅有 UP-NS 合併後，據 FreightWaves 報導分析師預期部分中介運輸客戶（如 STG）可能由 CSX 轉往 NS，屬預期而非已發生事實，列為 clue 待核原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
